_note: Example EV battery packs for the 3D explorer. Pack figures are public numbers where available; masses are estimates (marked) from cell format or from energy at typical cell energy density. Layout is illustrative.

pack_parts._note: Share of the NON-cell pack mass (housing, cooling, wiring, BMS). Typical values for a liquid-cooled EV pack.

top_cover.name: Top cover
top_cover.role: Seals the pack against water and dust, protects it in a crash.

cooling.name: Cooling plate
cooling.role: Liquid coolant pulls heat out of the cells to keep them at 20–40 °C.

busbars.name: Busbars & connectors
busbars.role: Join cells in series and parallel and carry the high-voltage current to the motor.

bms.name: BMS
bms.role: Monitors every cell's voltage, current and temperature; balances cells; stops over-charge and over-discharge.

base_frame.name: Base frame
base_frame.role: Holds the modules, takes crash loads, bolts the pack to the car floor.

tata_nexon_ev_45.name: Tata Nexon EV 45 kWh
tata_nexon_ev_45.mass_note: cell mass estimated from 45 kWh at ~165 Wh/kg (LFP cell level)
